tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: THE base color. Page background and every extruded/inset surface. Neumorphism only works if cards, buttons and wells share this exact color.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Optional slight tint inside inset wells (chart wells, terminal, inputs) so they read as recessed even when shadows are faint.

tokens.name: shadow-dark
tokens.usage: The dark half of every neumorphic shadow (bottom-right). Not for text.

tokens.name: shadow-light
tokens.usage: The light half of every neumorphic shadow (top-left). Not for text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: chart gridlines, dividers inside cards, timeline spine. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface / surface-sunken. 12:1 light, 12.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, labels, axis labels. 6.3:1 light, 7.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, captions. Still passes 4.5:1 on surface and sunken in both themes. Do not go lighter.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only (WCAG-exempt). Always paired with a flat, shadowless surface so disabled is shown twice.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: THE CTA. Fill of the primary button and nothing else. One per view. White text on it: 6.4:1 light, 5.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: red-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: red-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 3px solid, 4px offset, on every focusable thing. Max contrast on purpose, because neumorphic edges are soft.

tokens.name: status-building
tokens.usage: Text + dot of the 'building' pill. 5.1:1 light.

tokens.name: status-scoping
tokens.usage: Text + dot of the 'scoping' pill, and the current phase on a build map. 5.6:1 light.

tokens.name: status-dead
tokens.usage: Text of the 'dead' pill and the retired card's copy.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error messages and error icons (burnt amber, deliberately NOT the CTA red so red keeps one meaning).

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Follower growth line.

tokens.name: chart-point
tokens.usage: Hovered / latest point on a chart.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name. Desktop only; 44px on phones.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on stat tiles, pills, tabs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above page titles.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small wells, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, stat tiles, tabs rail.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panel, big wells.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, phase dots, icon buttons.

shadow.note: Neumorphism = two shadows from one light source (top-left). Raised = outward; inset = pressed into the surface. Use ONLY these; never hand-tune a shadow in a screen.

tokens.name: neu-raised-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, small buttons, the selected tab.

tokens.name: neu-raised-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, stat tiles, default cards.

tokens.name: neu-raised-lg
tokens.usage: Hover lift of interactive cards; hero panel.

tokens.name: neu-inset-sm
tokens.usage: Pressed state of buttons and tags; tabs rail; progress track groove.

tokens.name: neu-inset-md
tokens.usage: Wells: chart area, demo area, terminal.

tokens.name: neu-red-raised
tokens.usage: Primary (red) button resting.

tokens.name: neu-red-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: neu-flat
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and the retired (dead) project card: no depth = not alive.
